title: Make a reusable bounded stack
prompt: Stack<T> has a constructor capacity. push returns false without changing state when full. pop returns the newest item or std::nullopt when empty. It works for int and string; zero capacity is valid. This small exercise assumes T can be copied.
signature: template<class T> class Stack: push(T), optional<T> pop(), size() const

tests.label: String element
tests.hint: T is not fixed to int.

hints: vector stores elements of whatever type T names.
Compare size() with cap_ before push_back.
explanation: The template defines one container rule for several value types. optional marks an empty pop without inventing a fake T value. The vector belongs to the Stack.
